Inventor: Blake Poe
Examiner: Assres H. Woldermaryam

This amendment is being filed after a Notice of Allowance under 37 CFR § 1.312. By this Amendment, the specification has been amended to correct a minor error in the "CROSS- REFERENCE TO RELATED APPLICATIONS" section located at paragraph [0001] of the as-filed specification. The specification has been amended such that this section indicates that the parent application (U.S. App. No. 17/465,790) is a "continuation of' PCT/US2021/021793 and not a "U.S. national stage filing" from PCT/US2021/021793. This matches what is indicated in the Application Data Sheet as-filed.
It is submitted that the present application is in condition for allowance. Accordingly,

issuance of a notice of allowance indicating the allowability of these claims is respectfully requested. If there is any issue remaining to be resolved, the Examiner is invited to telephone the undersigned so that resolution can be promptly effected.

It is respectfully requested that, if necessary to effect a timely response, this paper be considered as a Petition for an Extension of Time sufficient to effect a timely response and that shortages in fees, if any, be charged to the Account of Barnes & Thornburg, Deposit Account No. 10- 0435, with reference to our file RADIA-0006-USCNT1 I 88042-375707.
